facts.fact: HIT told the Harare Commission of Inquiry that around 83 of Zimbabwe's 92 local authorities use at least one LADS module; which modules, and whether any records revenue, is not stated.
HIT says LADS links local authorities' services, including financials and billing, to the national public financial management system.

systems.platform: 38 modules in six categories: financial management, billing, asset management, procurement, accounts receivable and payable, debt checking
systems.tiers: deployed in Mutare and Masvingo cities; about 83 of 92 local authorities use at least one module

systems.system: Harare City Council South African ERP (unnamed)
systems.tiers: described only as a far more expensive South African system Harare sought instead of LADS
